_readme: University and institute repositories harvested over OAI-PMH by scripts/find_repo.py (backend find_repo). One entry per repository, vetted by hand: robots.txt (the OAI path and the full-text path must not be disallowed for *; an AI / dataset crawler opt-out or a challenge page rejects the repository), terms of use (a prohibition of systematic or bulk downloading rejects it), and two sample PDFs fetched with the honest tool User-Agent. `sets` is append-only (the rotation cursor indexes it); `all_sets` are sets dedicated to the built environment (no term gate, the off-domain title veto still applies); `relevant_fields` maps a metadata field to a pattern that marks a record as built-environment (a department or faculty name); `open_access` names the field that must state the open value (fail closed); `types` / `skip_types` override the default document types ('*' = a dedicated thesis repository without dc.type). `crawl_delay` is the robots.txt Crawl-delay (minimum 2 s) and paces both the finder and the loader (scripts/build_corpus.py makes every enabled host polite: serial, honest UA, per-run cap). Licence is classified per record (scripts/find_repo.py licence_of): collect regardless of licence, never a generic open. To add a repository: vet it, add the entry with its rights record, run tests/test_find_repo.py and scripts/check_contracts.py. `backlog` records candidates not enabled, with the verified reason. Run-time enforcement: the finder re-reads robots.txt and the pinned host policy before every request and redirect hop, and the loader keeps the polite-host settings for every configured host (also of disabled repositories) and defers rep- rows when this file cannot be loaded.

_policy.reject: robots.txt Disallow covering the OAI endpoint or the bitstream path for *; robots.txt Disallow: / (or ai-train opt-out) for AI / dataset crawlers such as ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, anthropic-ai; a WAF / JS / proof-of-work challenge on robots.txt, the OAI endpoint or the PDF; terms that prohibit systematic or bulk downloading or restrict access to registered users
_policy.go: OAI-PMH endpoint published for harvesting, full texts openly downloadable with an honest User-Agent, no prohibition found; rights are recorded per document
